title: Construction of the Great Pyramid of Giza
description:
The **Great Pyramid of Giza** was built around 2560 BC as a tomb for Pharaoh Khufu. It is the oldest and largest of the three pyramids in the Giza pyramid complex.

Originally standing at 146.6 meters, it was the tallest human-made structure in the world for over 3,800 years. The pyramid was built using an estimated 2.3 million stone blocks.

It is the only remaining wonder of the ancient world and continues to amaze visitors and researchers today.
